title: Cleartext Credentials in Files, Scripts, or Configuration

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1552.001 Credentials In Files

description: Plaintext passwords, API keys, or connection strings were found embedded in scripts, configuration files, source code, scheduled tasks, Group Policy Preferences, or on accessible file shares. Any user able to read these locations can harvest the credentials and reuse them against the associated systems.
businessImpact: High --- harvested credentials frequently provide direct access to databases, services, or privileged accounts, enabling lateral movement and data compromise.
remediation:
- Remove hardcoded secrets from code, scripts, and configuration.
- Store secrets in a dedicated secrets manager or vault and inject them at runtime.
- Rotate any credential that was exposed in cleartext.
- Restrict read access to configuration and share locations, and scan repositories/shares for secrets.
